description: This file contains Celery task definitions and related functions for scheduling, executing, and pruning reports and tasks within the Superset project. It includes task scheduling, execution logic, error handling, and status management for report and task workflows.

methods.name: log_task_failure
methods.description: Logs details when a Celery task fails, including task name and exception info.

methods.name: scheduler
methods.description: Main Celery beat scheduler for reports; schedules report alerts based on cron schedules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a report schedule task, handles errors, and updates task status.

methods.name: prune_log
methods.description: Prunes report schedule logs, handles timeout and command exceptions.

methods.name: prune_query
methods.description: Prunes old queries based on retention period, with deprecation warning for options usage.

methods.name: prune_logs
methods.description: Prunes logs with specified retention and max rows, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: prune_tasks
methods.description: Prunes async tasks with specified retention and max rows, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: execute_task
methods.description: Generic executor for GTF tasks; manages task lifecycle, context, error handling, and status updates.
